run_function_get_rows: run the get_rows function to fetch rows from a Hugging Face dataset split in streaming or normal mode
run_function_get_rows_or_raise: run the get_rows_or_raise function to fetch dataset rows with automatic fallback from streaming to normal mode on error
run_function_check_split_exists: run the check_split_exists function to verify a split exists in a config of a Hugging Face dataset
run_function_get_split_names: run the get_split_names function to retrieve all split names for a dataset config from the cache
run_function_get_file_extension: run the get_file_extension function to extract file extensions including recursive handling of compressed archives like .tar.gz
